description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerServiceMock for the IWebAudioPlayerService interface, used for unit testing web audio player services in the Rialto project. It includes mock method declarations for creating, destroying, controlling playback, and querying the state of web audio players.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServiceMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayerService for testing purposes.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks creation of a web audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks destruction of a web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks starting playback of the specified web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks pausing the specified web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks setting end-of-stream for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieving available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieving buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer of the specified player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieving device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks setting the volume for the specified player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume of the specified player.
